official: 目黒区介護保険条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会の資料
令和8年第1回定例会の議決結果

name: 介護保険料の所得基準を見直し
summary: 保険料率の算定に使う所得基準の一部は、これまで809,000円でした。この議案では基準を826,500円に改め、令和8年度分の保険料率について、給与収入に応じた所得計算や住民税の課税・非課税の扱いに特例を設けます。
changes: 保険料率の算定に使う所得基準の一部を809,000円から826,500円に引き上げる
給与収入に応じた所得の算定方法に特例を設ける
一定の条件に当てはまる人を住民税が課税されている者として扱う
who: 介護保険の第1号被保険者
対象となる第1号被保険者と同じ世帯の世帯主や世帯員
why: 保険料率の算定に使う所得基準を見直し、令和7年度税制改正による給与所得控除の最低保障額の引上げの影響を令和8年度の算定で遮断するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises income thresholds for long-term care insurance premiums
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Meguro City Long-Term Care Insurance Ordinance
en.summary: Some of the income thresholds used to calculate premium rates have been ¥809,000. This bill changes the threshold to ¥826,500 and establishes special rules for calculating income based on salary income and for treating resident tax as taxable or non-taxable when calculating premium rates for FY2026.
changes: Raises one of the income thresholds used to calculate premium rates from ¥809,000 to ¥826,500
Establishes a special rule for calculating income based on salary income
Treats people who meet certain conditions as being subject to resident tax
who: Category 1 insured persons under long-term care insurance
Household heads and household members in the same household as eligible Category 1 insured persons
en.why: The ward says this is to revise the income threshold used to calculate premium rates and to prevent the impact of the increase in the minimum guaranteed amount of the employment income deduction under the FY2025 tax reform from affecting the FY2026 calculation.
